units.source_text: “哪里，做生意，龙助也是个新手，还不在行。

en.t: No, when it comes to business, Ryusuke is still a beginner and not yet experienced.

units.source_text: 做父亲的，说出这话未免那个，不过这孩子办事倒也牢靠……”

en.t: As his father, it may be a little awkward for me to say this, but the boy is quite reliable in the way he handles things...
